answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the yarrow of free entry disappears, the ripple of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the inlet case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
